related_stores.about_content:
Myntra is India's largest online fashion and lifestyle marketplace, founded in 2007 and now owned by Flipkart, which is a subsidiary of Walmart. Headquartered in Bengaluru, Myntra hosts over 6,000 brands and more than 1 million products across clothing, footwear, accessories, beauty, and home decor. It serves customers across 19,000+ pin codes in India and processes millions of orders every month, making it the go-to destination for fashion shopping online in India.


Myntra caters to men, women, and kids across every price point, from affordable everyday basics to premium international labels. The platform features both Indian brands like Biba, W, and FabIndia alongside global names like H&M, Zara, Nike, Puma, Adidas, Levi's, and Mango. Whether you are shopping for ethnic wear, western casuals, activewear, or formal office attire, Myntra covers the full range.

How to Get Myntra Coupons



Getting Myntra coupons is straightforward if you know where to look. CouponPush lists all active and verified Myntra coupon codes updated daily, so you do not have to search multiple sites or test expired codes. Here are all the ways to get Myntra coupons and discount offers:

CouponPush: Browse the verified Myntra coupon codes listed on this page. All codes are tested before being published. Click Show Code to copy, or click Activate Deal for offers that apply automatically at checkout.

Myntra App Notifications: Enable push notifications on the Myntra app to receive exclusive app-only coupon codes, flash sale alerts, and personalized offers based on your browsing history.

Myntra Insider Program: Myntra Insider is a free loyalty program open to all registered users. Insiders get early access to sale events, exclusive discount codes on the 28th of every month, and access to limited-edition collections before they go live for the general public.

Email and SMS: Subscribe to Myntra's newsletter to receive first-order discount codes, birthday offers worth 20 to 30 percent off, and seasonal sale announcements directly in your inbox.

Bank and Card Offers: Myntra regularly runs bank-specific coupon offers in partnership with HDFC, Axis, Kotak, and ICICI. These give an additional 10 to 20 percent instant discount over and above any promo code or sale price.

Influencer and Brand Campaigns: Myntra partners with fashion influencers on Instagram and YouTube who share exclusive coupon codes as part of campaign collaborations. These codes are often time-limited but can offer 15 to 25 percent off with no minimum order requirement.

Myntra Product Categories



Women's Fashion


Myntra's women's section is the largest category on the platform. It covers ethnic wear including sarees, salwar kameez, kurtis, lehengas, and fusion wear from brands like Biba, W, Aurelia, Anouk, and Libas. Western wear includes dresses, tops, jeans, co-ord sets, and blazers from H&M, Zara, Mango, and Only. Myntra's own label, Here&Now, offers trendy basics at accessible prices. Discounts on women's fashion regularly go up to 70 to 80 percent during End of Reason Sale and Pink Friday events.

Men's Fashion


Men's clothing on Myntra spans casual shirts, t-shirts, jeans, chinos, formal trousers, sweatshirts, and ethnic kurtas from brands like Roadster, Highlander, Levis, Jack and Jones, Arrow, and Louis Philippe. Athleisure and activewear from Puma, Adidas, and Reebok are among the most searched categories. Wedding and festive collection deals are particularly sharp, with extra 10 percent coupon codes available on sherwanis, kurta sets, and blazers.

Footwear


Myntra stocks footwear for men, women, and kids across casual, formal, sports, and ethnic categories. Top brands include Nike, Puma, Adidas, Skechers, Clarks, Steve Madden, and Metro. Sports shoes and sneakers see the most frequent coupon codes, with flat discounts and bank offers regularly available on cart values above Rs.799.

Beauty and Personal Care


Myntra Beauty covers makeup, skincare, haircare, fragrances, and grooming from brands including Maybelline, Lakme, L'Oreal, Cetaphil, Minimalist, Mamaearth, and Forest Essentials. Myntra often runs additional coupon codes specifically for the beauty category with no minimum order value, making it a good place to stock up on skincare essentials at a discount.

Kids and Baby


Myntra's kids section covers clothing, footwear, and accessories for newborns to teenagers from brands like H&M Kids, US Polo Assn Kids, Mothercare, and FirstCry. School uniform essentials, seasonal clothing, and festive outfits for children frequently see extra coupon code discounts during back-to-school periods and Diwali sales.

Accessories and Home


Watches, sunglasses, bags, belts, and jewellery are available from Fastrack, Fossil, Titan, Hidesign, and Accessorize. Myntra also carries a curated home decor section with bedding, cushions, and lifestyle products. Coupon codes on accessories typically require a minimum cart value of Rs.799 or above.
related_stores.howto_content:
Myntra coupon codes work differently on the app versus the website, and it is important to know the correct steps to make sure your discount applies successfully before you place the order.


How to Add Coupon in Myntra App



Step 1: Open the Myntra app on your phone and browse for the product you want to buy.

Step 2: Add the product to your bag by tapping the Add to Bag button on the product page.

Step 3: Tap the bag icon at the bottom right of the screen to open your cart.

Step 4: Review your items and tap Proceed to Buy.

Step 5: On the order summary page, look for the field that says Have a Coupon Code? or Apply Coupon. Tap on it.

Step 6: A list of available coupons will appear. You can either select one from the list or manually type or paste the coupon code you copied from CouponPush.

Step 7: Tap Apply. The discount will reflect immediately in your order total on the same screen.

Step 8: Select your delivery address and payment method, then place the order.

Note: Most Myntra promo codes are valid on the app only. If a code is not working on the website, switch to the Myntra app and try again.

How to Apply Coupon in Myntra Website



Step 1: Visit myntra.com and log into your account.

Step 2: Add your chosen items to the bag and click on the bag icon at the top right.

Step 3: Review your cart and click Proceed to Buy.

Step 4: On the checkout page, scroll to the section that says Apply Coupon Code.

Step 5: Type or paste the promo code from CouponPush into the field and click Apply.

Step 6: Confirm the discounted price appears in the order summary before selecting your payment method.

Step 7: Complete your payment and place the order.

How to Use Myntra Coupon for First Order



New Myntra users get access to exclusive first-order coupon codes that give a flat discount of Rs.200 to Rs.500 on a minimum purchase. To use a first-order coupon, create a new Myntra account with your mobile number or email, add products to your cart that meet the minimum order value stated in the offer, and apply the first-order promo code at checkout. First-order codes are valid on the Myntra app only and are linked to your registered mobile number, so they cannot be reused on a second account with the same number.

Best Times to Shop on Myntra with Coupons



End of Reason Sale (EORS): Myntra's flagship twice-yearly sale held in June and December. Discounts go up to 80 percent across all categories with additional bank offers and exclusive app coupon codes. This is the best time of year to shop on Myntra.

Pink Friday Sale: Myntra's answer to Black Friday, held in November. Deep discounts on beauty, fashion, and footwear with extra flat-off coupon codes for app users.

Myntra Diwali Sale: Held in October, this sale focuses on festive and ethnic wear with up to 70 percent off on sherwanis, lehengas, and kurtis, plus extra coupon codes on wedding wear collections.

Big Fashion Festival: Usually held around Republic Day in January. Up to 80 percent off with bank coupon offers giving an additional 10 percent instant discount.

Monthly Insider Offers: Myntra Insider members receive exclusive discount codes on the 28th of every month regardless of any ongoing sale. These are small but consistent savings for regular shoppers.

Tips to Save More on Myntra



Stack a promo code with a bank offer. Myntra allows you to apply one promo code and one bank-specific discount on the same order. This is the most effective way to maximize savings, particularly during sale events when both types of discounts are active simultaneously.

Download the Myntra app for app-exclusive codes. Most high-value Myntra coupon codes including first-order discounts are only valid on the app. Shopping through the website will not give you access to these codes.

Join Myntra Insider for free. The Insider program costs nothing and gives you early sale access, monthly discount codes, and exclusive product drops that are not available to regular users.

Check your Myntra Credit balance before checkout. Myntra Credit is earned through referrals, gift cards, and refunds. It can be applied at checkout like a coupon to get an additional reduction on your order total.

Buy combos and sets instead of individual items. Myntra regularly offers bundle deals where buying two or three items together gives a larger combined discount than buying each product separately. Look for Buy 2 Get 1 or Buy 3 Get Extra 30% Off deals on the offers page.

store.description: Compare Porter coupon codes for two-wheeler goods transport, mini trucks, tempos and other eligible services. An app coupon or first-time booking offer may depend on your city, account and service. Confirm the discount in the Porter booking summary.
store.about_content:
Porter coupon codes and app offers

Porter provides goods transportation through its app, including two-wheelers, mini trucks and tempos, with packers and movers offered for eligible moves. Choose the service and pickup location first because availability and fares depend on the booking details. A Porter coupon code can reduce an eligible booking only when the promotion applies to that city, account and service.

Porter app coupon code for your booking

Check the offers shown in your Porter app and the official Porter offers page. Select your city, review any listed code and read its conditions before booking. An offer shown for one service or location may not apply to another.

Porter first-time coupon code

Searches for a Porter first-time coupon code or a Porter coupon code for first-time users do not establish that a welcome offer is active. Check the promotion's definition of a new user, eligible service, city, booking value and expiry. If your account does not show an eligible offer, compare the quoted fare without assuming a first-booking discount.

Compare the actual saving

Enter the same pickup, drop-off, stops and goods details when comparing options. Review the vehicle type, estimated fare and any extra charges shown for the booking. Count a coupon saving only after it appears in the final booking summary.

Browse all CouponPush stores for more offers. Porter service details come from its official services page. Rating: 4.9/5 for the Porter iPhone app on the India App Store, checked 17 September 2026. This is an external app rating, not a CouponPush customer-review score.
store.howto_content:
1. Open the Porter app and sign in.
  2. Choose the goods transport or moving service available in your city.
  3. Enter pickup and drop-off locations, stops and goods details to view the booking estimate.
  4. Open the coupon or offers field, enter an eligible Porter coupon code if one is available, and apply it.
  5. Check that the discount appears in the booking summary, then review the final fare and service details before confirming.

Why is my Porter coupon code not working?

Check spelling, expiry, city, service type, account eligibility, minimum booking value and any usage limit. A first-time offer may be restricted to a qualifying first booking. If the app still rejects the code, use the live promotion terms or Porter support rather than assuming the discount will be added later.
store.terms_content:
Porter promotions may change by city, account, service and date. Check the live offers page and app before booking. CouponPush does not promise that a code or first-time discount is currently available.

  • Minimum booking amounts, discount caps, service exclusions and one-use limits may apply.
  • The quoted fare and additional charges depend on the booking details. Confirm the payable amount in the app.
  • Do not assume that two promotions can be combined or that a past code is still valid.

Porter coupon code FAQs

Is there a Porter coupon code for first-time users?

There is no universal first-time code confirmed for every account and city. Check offers shown in the app and read the terms for any new-user promotion before booking.

Where do I enter a Porter app coupon code?

Choose your service and enter the booking details in the Porter app, then use the coupon or offers field when it is available. Confirm that the fare changes before you place the booking.

Can I use the same Porter coupon for a two-wheeler and a mini truck?

Only if the promotion explicitly covers both services. Check the eligible vehicle or service types in the live terms.

Why is my Porter first-time coupon code rejected?

The account, city, service, minimum fare, validity period or prior-booking history may make the booking ineligible. Review the exact promotion conditions in the app.

How do I know if a Porter coupon worked?

The booking summary should show the discount and updated payable fare. If it does not, do not count the saving.
